- Ability to evaluate and develop clinical development strategies, study concepts, and clinical trial designs.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Computer Vision and Multimodal AI for the Early Detection of Parkinson’s (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The following full-time (38.5 hours/week) position is to be filled as soon as possible at the Center of Neurology of the University Hospital Bonn:

Postdoctoral Researcher in Computer Vision and Multimodal AI for the Early Detection of Parkinson’s Disease (m/w/d)

The position is fixed-term until 30 September 2028 due to the duration of the research project.

Parkinson’s disease is usually diagnosed only after substantial neurodegeneration has already occurred. Subtle changes in movement, facial expression and speech may emerge years earlier, but current clinical assessments are not designed to detect and quantify them at scale. We believe that computer vision and multimodal AI can help close this gap - and that meaningful progress requires researchers who want to apply cutting-edge methods to a major clinical challenge.

Our goal is to develop objective and scalable digital tools for the early detection and monitoring of Parkinson’s disease. We combine video-based analysis of gait, balance, facial expression and limb movements with speech, touchscreen and wearable sensor data. A particular focus is on individuals with isolated REM sleep behavior disorder, who are at high risk of developing Parkinson’s disease or related neurodegenerative disorders.

The group of Prof. Dr. Michael Sommerauer at the Center of Neurology at the University Hospital Bonn and the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) is seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to join our interdisciplinary team.

The successful candidate will take a leading role in the development of the computer vision components of bradyMX, our multimodal digital motor assessment platform. The position is embedded in the ERC-funded Re-START PD research program and offers the opportunity to work with unique, deeply phenotyped clinical cohorts and longitudinal datasets. Rather than developing methods in isolation, you will work closely with clinicians and neuroscientists to translate methodological advances into tools that may improve patient stratification, clinical trials and, ultimately, the way Parkinson’s disease is detected.

Please submit your application as a single PDF, including: 

• a cover letter describing your scientific interests and motivation for joining the group 

• a curriculum vitae including a publication list 

• contact details for at least two referees

Your responsibilities:

- Lead the development of computer vision methods for quantifying subtle motor abnormalities from clinical video recordings
- Develop robust pipelines for human pose estimation, facial and body landmark detection, movement segmentation, tracking, feature extraction and automated quality control
- Design and evaluate machine-learning and deep-learning models for the analysis of gait, balance, facial expression and upper- and lower-limb movements
- Investigate temporal modelling, representation learning and interpretable movement features for the detection and monitoring of early motor dysfunction
- Integrate video-derived features with complementary digital modalities such as speech, touchscreen tasks, inertial sensors and clinical assessments
- Evaluate model robustness and generalizability across participants, recording conditions, devices and international study sites
- Work closely with the clinical research team on study design, data collection, annotation strategies and the interpretation of model outputs
- Prepare scientific manuscripts, present results at international conferences and contribute to grant applications
- Support the supervision of doctoral, Master’s and medical students

Your profile:

- - A doctoral degree in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, biomedical engineering, medical informatics or a closely related discipline
- Strong experience in machine learning and deep learning for image, video or human movement analysis
- Excellent programming skills in Python and practical experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX
- Experience in one or more of the following areas: human pose estimation, motion tracking, action recognition, temporal modelling, self-supervised learning, multimodal learning or domain adaptation
- A sound understanding of experimental design, quantitative model evaluation and reproducible research practices
- Experience with version control and collaborative software development; knowledge of containerized workflows and high-performance computing is an advantage
- Interest in translating methodological advances into clinically meaningful applications; previous experience in Parkinson’s disease or medical research is welcome but not required
- A high degree of scientific curiosity, independence and commitment to rigorous research
- Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international environment
- Very good command of written and spoken English; German language skills are not required

What we offer: 

- The opportunity to lead an innovative research project at the intersection of computer vision, multimodal AI, neurology and digital health
- Access to unique, deeply phenotyped cohorts of individuals at risk of Parkinson’s disease, healthy controls and patients with early Parkinson’s disease
- Rich video, sensor and clinical datasets collected using standardized multimodal assessment protocols
- A direct path from methodological development to external validation and clinically relevant application
- Close collaboration with neurologists, neuroscientists, and international experts in Parkinson’s disease and digital biomarkers
- An excellent research environment at the University Hospital Bonn, the University of Bonn and the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases
- Access to modern computational infrastructure and support for reproducible data analysis and software development
- Strong support for scientific publications, conference participation, grant applications and the development of an independent academic profile
- Opportunities to supervise junior researchers and contribute to a growing interdisciplinary research group
- Responsible and diverse: A position with plenty of room for creativity and responsibility within a supportive and collegial team

jobs.occupation: Laborant in der Qualitätskontrolle (m/w/d) - Schwerpunkt Methodenetablierung (Chemielaborant/in)
jobs.description:
Your role: Laboratory Assistant in Quality Control (m/f/d)

The position is initially limited to 2 years.

In this technically demanding role, you will be largely responsible for the practical implementation and maintenance of our analytical test procedures. Your focus will be on ensuring robust analysis in accordance with international standards directly in the laboratory.

Your Responsibilities:

- Wide-ranging analysis: You will apply chromatographic (HPLC, GC) and wet chemical methods to ensure precise quality control, maintaining data integrity through GMP-compliant documentation and modern laboratory standards (e.g., 5S).
- Pharmacopoeia compliance: You will independently establish and verify analytical methods according to applicable monographs (e.g. EP, USP) and carry out verifications in regulatory revisions.
- Method optimization & CAPA management: You will experimentally investigate and optimize analytical procedures in the context of deviations and CAPA measures to sustainably increase methodological robustness.
- Conducting validation studies: You will carry out method validations and verifications for new products and feedstocks practically on the device and strictly comply with GMP requirements.
- Securing method transfer (APVs): You will develop "best practices" for analytics and record them in supplementary audit regulations (APVs) to ensure consistent application of the methods across the team.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

- Education: You have completed training as a chemical laboratory assistant (m/f/d), CTA (m/f/d) or a comparable qualification and 2+ years relevant professional experience in pharmaceutical quality control.
- Expertise: You have in-depth, field-tested knowledge in instrumental analysis (HPLC, GC, spectroscopy) as well as in the application of international pharmacopoeia (EP, USP).
- Languages: Fluent German and good English skills for working with international pharmacopoeia.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Methodological competence: Experience in the practical processing of methodological issues in the context of CAPA processes and in the implementation of method validations.
- Way of working: High level of technical understanding of laboratory processes, work reliably in the implementation of complex monographs and passion for working directly in the laboratory.
- IT affinity: Experience with MS Office and chromatography data systems (e.g. Empower) and SAP.

What we offer you – Why Elanco?

- Attractive salary according to the chemical tariff (MTV), full 13th month salary (Christmas bonus) and 40 € holiday pay per day. Plus: employer-financed pension scheme**.**

- Convenient commute: Subsidy for the job ticket and free parking.
- Benefits: Employee share purchase program and corporate benefits platform.

- Travel: 0%
- Position: Limited contract of 2 years.

WHY CFAB?Behind every campaign, every product, and every growth milestone stands a team that takes ownership, moves fast, and delivers results. That is what cfab is all about.What looks like a strong brand from the outside is powered by high performance, fast execution, and people who work with real intensity to drive our growth every day.As a Media Buyer (m/f/d) , you will take operational and strategic ownership of our Paid Media activities. You will make sure our brands reach the right people, budgets are used efficiently, and media spend translates into measurable growth.You will work closely with Creative, Brand, Content and Data to continuously develop our campaigns. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to build new brands from the ground up and develop Paid Media structures for new growth opportunities.
YOUR IMPACT
• Manage and scale our Paid Media campaigns across relevant platforms
• Own campaign structure, Paid Media budgets, targeting and continuous optimization
• Develop and execute Performance Marketing strategies for different brands and target audiences
• Analyze performance KPIs and derive concrete optimization measures
• Continuously test creatives, audiences, placements and campaign structures
• Work closely with Creative and Brand to develop performance-driven ad creatives
• Identify new growth opportunities and scale successful campaigns
• Build and optimize Paid Media setups for new brands
• Monitor budgets, ROAS, CAC, CPM, CTR, CVR and other relevant KPIs
• Create regular performance reports and derive clear recommendations
• Monitor new platforms, trends and advertising features
• Work with internal teams and external partners to continuously develop our Media setup

WHY YOU WOULD BE A GOOD FIT FOR US
• Several years of hands-on experience in Paid Media or Performance Marketing
• Strong experience with Meta Ads and ideally other Paid Media platforms
• Experience building, managing and scaling Performance Marketing campaigns
• Confident working with performance KPIs and data-driven optimization
• Experience with creative testing and developing performance-driven advertising creatives
• Strong understanding of customer journeys, funnels and conversion
• Experience in E-Commerce , D2C, Fashion or a comparable consumer business is a plus
• Analytical and structured approach
• Entrepreneurial mindset and strong hands-on mentality
• High level of initiative and ownership
• Fast execution and a willingness to test new approaches
• Fluent English and Dutch , with a minimum proficiency level of C1 in both languages
• Willingness to work from our headquarters in Düsseldorf at least 4 days per week

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT CFAB
• Permanent employment
• 31 vacation days
• Flexible working hours
• Apple equipment (MacBook, iPhone)
• Employer-paid team lunch three times a week
• Monthly tax-free benefits of your choice
• Corporate Benefits and discounts
• Manicure and barber appointments at the office
• Monthly product vouchers
• Optional company car after the probation period
• Personal birthday voucher
• Regular team events and celebrations
• Plenty of room for your own ideas, ownership and active contribution

WHAT MOTIVATES USAt cfab ambition and speed go hand in hand with high standards for our work. We don’t just want to develop ideas: we want to bring them to life quickly and see what comes of them. For us, it’s not just about good ideas, but above all about the results they produce.Our growth is driven by people who set high standards, drive things forward, and want to grow alongside us. Here you’ll have the space to take on responsibility, develop your skills, and make your own impact visible.READY TO CREATE WHAT’S NEXT? Let’s make it happen.

jobs.occupation: Head of Planning - Forecasting, Demand & Ordering (m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description:
#BEcomeMAXXYou’re passionate about data, numbers, and logic rather than gut feeling? You think analytically, love clear structures, and want to take full ownership of one of the most critical decision areas in the company? Then this role is for you.
As Head of Forecasting, you are the single analytical authority for all sales and demand forecasts at IronMaxx. You define the logic, methodology, and quality of the forecast end-to-end. With you, the forecast stands or falls.
Demand Planning is part of your responsibility – derived from the forecast and deliberately kept lean and standardized. Your focus is not operational complexity, but forecast accuracy, transparency, and reliability as the foundation for all downstream decisions.
Ready to perform? Your tasks with MAXXimum focus Forecast Ownership & Analytical Excellence
• End-to-end responsibility for sales and demand forecasts across all channels and markets.
• Definition, continuous improvement, and enforcement of forecast logic and methodology as a single source of truth.
• Acting as the final decision-making authority for all forecast-related questions and adjustments.
• Establishment and ownership of a structured forecast cycle including reviews, adjustments, and decision gates.
• Deep analysis of forecast accuracy, bias, and deviations with clear corrective actions.

Demand Planning – derived & simplified
• Conceptual responsibility for Demand Planning as a direct and consistent derivation of the forecast.
• Reduction of complexity through standardization, clear rules, and transparent assumptions.
• Ensuring demand figures are plausible, explainable, and actionable for Supply Chain and Operations.
• Close alignment with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Production to translate forecasts into executable plans.

Data, Tools & Governance
• Methodological ownership of forecasting models, KPIs, and planning tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline).
• Continuous improvement of data quality, transparency, and reproducibility.
• Development of scenarios, simulations, and what-if analyses to support management and financial decisions.
• Collaboration with Finance to align forecast, budget, and business cases.

Leadership & Cross-functional Alignment
• Functional and disciplinary leadership of the Planning & Ordering team with a strong analytical focus.
• Clear positioning of Sales, eCommerce, and Product Development as structured input providers, not forecast owners.
• Sparring partner for Management – fact-based, structured, and data-driven.
• Responsibility for relevant KPIs, performance monitoring, and reporting.

Your skillset - as strong as our protein
• Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Data Analytics, or a comparable field.
• Several years of experience in Forecasting / Sales Forecasting / Demand Forecasting (ideally FMCG: Food and E-Commerce).
• Proven ownership of forecast quality, logic, and methodology.
• Strong analytical mindset and ownership responsibility
• Excellent command of ERP and forecasting tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline) and advanced Excel skills.
• Leadership experience with a structured, clarity-driven management style.
• Very good English skills, German Skills are a plus

About us Quality & Innovations from IronMaxx® Nutrition
Premium sports nutrition - Designed in Germany!
Producing the best sports nutrition worldwide is the goal of IronMaxx®.

The production of highly efficient sports nutrition of the best quality and the constant further development of our products led to the award of the State Prize for Excellent Food Quality by the State of North Rhine-Westphalia. However, this is no reason for us to rest on our laurels - we are constantly working with the greatest passion to offer you supplements that inspire, work and taste great! The integration of the latest study results and the evaluation of practical field research in cooperation with professional sports clubs and our customers have led to permanent innovation in the development of new sports and fitness nutrition at IronMaxx® Nutrition since the company was founded in 2004.

In addition to the basics of sports nutrition in the areas of strength/endurance, muscle building and diet , this includes effective nutritional supplements for health and prevention , intelligent new combinations of active ingredients and improved dosage forms, such as our Tricaps® .

In the area of protein products, for example, IronMaxx® has set a milestone in the evolution of the latest sports nutrition products with the development of water-based protein powders in over 31 flavors. The sweet spread with the world's highest protein content , IronMaxx® Protein Creme, also comes from us.

Designed in Germany - as a German sports nutrition manufacturer, IronMaxx® is also committed to outstanding quality and seamless quality control.

High performance - the goal is the goal.

Well-known professional clubs, such as the eight-time German ice hockey champions, the "Kölner Haie", or the traditional handball club VfL Gummersbach with its unique success story, have relied for years on the efficient sports nutrition from IronMaxx® and on our expertise in the use and mode of action of nutritional supplements.

While in many areas of life the "path is often proclaimed as the goal", our customers usually have a very clear idea of their "dream body" and its desired performance. This passion to achieve their personal goa l is something we share with all our partners and customers - be it an athletic body, achieving new personal bests, reducing body weight or achieving sporting team success.

IronMaxx® products have therefore become an integral part of the product range of many European fitness studios, wholesalers, pharmacies and body stores in recent years due to their high quality.

jobs.occupation: Senior Demand Planner (m/f/d) (Demand Planner)
jobs.description:
#BEcomeMAXXYou enjoy turning forecasts into reality? You like structure, numbers, and processes — but you’re equally strong in leading people, creating clarity, and keeping teams aligned? Then this role is made for you.
As Senior Demand Planning Manager, you own the operational and tactical Demand Planning at IronMaxx. You translate centrally defined forecasts into stable demand, inventory, and ordering decisions, lead your team with clarity and empathy, and act as a close sparring partner to the Head of Forecasting.
While the final ownership of the forecast lies with the Head of Forecasting, you ensure that forecasts work in reality — operationally sound, executable, and stable across the supply chain.
Ready to perform? Your tasks with MAXXimum focus Demand Planning Ownership
• End-to-end responsibility for operational and tactical demand planning, derived from the central forecast.
• Ensuring high product availability, stable inventory levels, and efficient replenishment.
• Creation, maintenance, and validation of demand, inventory, and ordering plans.
• Continuous monitoring of stock levels, safety stock, lead times, and sales performance.
• Early identification of risks such as shortages, overstocks, or supply bottlenecks.

Buying & Supplier Coordination
• Close operational collaboration with Purchasing and suppliers regarding orders, quantities, and delivery schedules.
• Tracking delivery dates, production status, and proactive escalation of delays or risks.
• Ensuring a smooth and reliable flow of goods across the supply chain.

Sparring & Cross-functional Collaboration
• Acting as a key sparring partner to the Head of Forecasting, providing operational feedback and plausibility checks on forecasts.
• Close alignment with Sales, Customer Success, Logistics, Production, and Procurement.
• Translating strategic forecast assumptions into executable operational actions.

Processes, Tools & Continuous Improvement
• Hands-on use and further development of demand planning and ERP tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline).
• Identification and implementation of operational improvements in demand planning, replenishment, and buying processes.
• Contribution to scenario analyses, data evaluations, and cross-functional process optimization projects.

Your skillset - as strong as our protein
• Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a comparable qualification.
• Several years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Purchasing, or related fields, ideally with leadership responsibility.
• Strong analytical and structured mindset with high numerical affinity.
• Proven experience in leading teams (disciplinary and/or functional).
• Strong people skills: clear, empathetic, reliable, and collaborative
• Confident handling of ERP and demand planning tools (e.g. SAP, Streamline).
• Solution-oriented, hands-on, and execution-driven working style.
• Very good English skills, German skills are mandatory
